Data:Commit.nyc.s.seastories.json.label: The Wolf-Wife
Data:Commit.nyc.s.seastories.json.startdescription: The Ligeian Rowena, holder of the Mare's Key, called sea-opener, wolf-wife. Whom did she invite from Ys behind the wave? When the moon sets across the sea, will they follow its road again? This matter of roads and keys is Nyctodromy.
Data:Commit.nyc.s.seastories.json.desc: The Ligeian Rowena, holder of the Mare's Key, called sea-opener, wolf-wife. Whom did she invite from Ys behind the wave? When the moon sets across the sea, will they follow its road again?

Data:Commit.nyc.s.sickle.eclipse.json.label: Words to Walk By
Data:Commit.nyc.s.sickle.eclipse.json.startdescription: Unwise words unlocked unwise doors; we can use wise words to lock them. This is a matter of Nyctodromy.
Data:Commit.nyc.s.sickle.eclipse.json.desc: Unwise words unlocked unwise doors; we can use wise words to lock them.

Data:Commit.nyc.s.sights.sensations.json.label: An End
Data:Commit.nyc.s.sights.sensations.json.startdescription: The artist knows: their every work could be improved. The artist understands: perfect work exists Nowhere. To go Nowhere - to go below the world - is not an easy journey. But there the artist could achieve their utmost. Nyctodromy is the way to perfection.
Data:Commit.nyc.s.sights.sensations.json.desc: The artist knows: their every work could be improved. The artist understands: perfect work exists Nowhere. To go Nowhere - to go below the world - is not an easy journey. But there the artist could achieve their utmost.

Data:Commit.nyc.s.strings.songs.json.label: The Passage
Data:Commit.nyc.s.strings.songs.json.startdescription: Words are the way through the sky, and a song without words is no song at all. Nyctodromy is the wisdom of ways.
Data:Commit.nyc.s.strings.songs.json.desc: Words are the way through the sky, and a song without words is no song at all.

Data:Commit.nyc.s.vak.json.label: An Arrangement
Data:Commit.nyc.s.vak.json.startdescription: Something not commonly understood: without Vak, the exception, there could be no Calyptra, the law. Vak is in this sense, and perhaps in every sense, Calyptra's servant. This is known to scholars of the Night Arts.
Data:Commit.nyc.s.vak.json.desc: Something not commonly understood: without Vak, the exception, there could be no Calyptra, the law. Vak is in this sense, and perhaps in every sense, Calyptra's servant.

Data:Commit.nyc.s.watchmansparadoxes.jso.label: From Change
Data:Commit.nyc.s.watchmansparadoxes.jso.startdescription: We recognise the dream-places that the Watchman shows us, though we have never seen them before. Perhaps we were something else when we saw them. This paradox is fundamental to Nyctodromy.
Data:Commit.nyc.s.watchmansparadoxes.jso.desc: We recognise the dream-places that the Watchman shows us, though we have never seen them before. Perhaps we were something else when we saw them.

Data:Commit.pre.s.cracktrack.json.label: A Tongue of Earth
Data:Commit.pre.s.cracktrack.json.startdescription: Cracktrack is the native tongue of the living world. As long as Cracktrack is spoken, in cloud-shape and hill-form, life persists. This is a matter of Preservation.
Data:Commit.pre.s.cracktrack.json.desc: Cracktrack is the native tongue of the living world. As long as Cracktrack is spoken, in cloud-shape and hill-form, life persists.

Data:Commit.pre.s.edictsinviolable.json.label: Night
Data:Commit.pre.s.edictsinviolable.json.startdescription: The Velvet is not the oldest Hour; but she is the oldest Hour of Calyptra. The Black Flower on the Watchman's Tree is the preservation of secrets, and without it the Tree would fall. This is a matter of Preservation.
Data:Commit.pre.s.edictsinviolable.json.desc: The Velvet is not the oldest Hour; but she is the oldest Hour of Calyptra. The Black Flower on the Watchman's Tree is the preservation of secrets, and without it the Tree would fall.

Data:Commit.pre.s.herbs.infusions.json.label: The Source and the Root
Data:Commit.pre.s.herbs.infusions.json.startdescription: In the inmost walled garden of the palace of the Shadowless Kings in Persia, there was preserved a yew-tree older than any other. The Kings set a bee-hive in its branches, in memory of their forefathers, and they brewed from its flowers a sovereign cure against all poisons. This is the root of all our science, and this is Preservation.
Data:Commit.pre.s.herbs.infusions.json.desc: In the inmost walled garden of the palace of the Shadowless Kings in Persia, there was preserved a yew-tree older than any other. The Kings set a bee-hive in its branches, in memory of their forefathers, and they brewed from its flowers a sovereign cure against all poisons. This is the root of all our science.

Data:Commit.pre.s.hill.hollow.json.label: How They Endured
Data:Commit.pre.s.hill.hollow.json.startdescription: In the beginning, the Carapace Cross served the first Hours, the gods born from stone. When the gods-from-stone were defeated, where could the Cross go? Into the hills; into the Bounds; and into us. This is how humankind came to be, and in our most secret hollows, the Cross endures. This is a matter of Preservation.
Data:Commit.pre.s.hill.hollow.json.desc: In the beginning, the Carapace Cross served the first Hours, the gods born from stone. When the gods-from-stone were defeated, where could the Cross go? Into the hills; into the Bounds; and into us. This is how humankind came to be, and in our most secret hollows, the Cross endures.

Data:Commit.pre.s.inks.containment.json.label: When It Is Safe
Data:Commit.pre.s.inks.containment.json.startdescription: Certain knowledge is forbidden to mortals… except in nine great libraries protected by the covenant-stones they hold, where this knowledge can be safely recorded in the inks called encaustum terminale. These libraries are together called the Watchman's Tree, and the covenant marked by these stones shares that name. All this, then, is a matter of Preservation.
Data:Commit.pre.s.inks.containment.json.desc: Certain knowledge is forbidden to mortals… except in nine great libraries protected by the covenant-stones they hold, where this knowledge can be safely recorded in the inks called encaustum. These libraries are together called the Watchman's Tree, and the covenant marked by these stones shares that name.

Data:Commit.pre.s.maggephenemysteries.js.label: Rebirth
Data:Commit.pre.s.maggephenemysteries.js.startdescription: The gods-who-are, which we call the Hours, warred against the gods-from-stone and cast them down. What remains of the gods-from-stone we call plague, scourge, catastrophe. But if the gods-from-stone were reborn, would they still be plagues? Would renewal bring peace? The Arts Unregarded hint that it might be so.
Data:Commit.pre.s.maggephenemysteries.js.desc: The gods-who-are, which we call the Hours, warred against the gods-from-stone and cast them down. What remains of the gods-from-stone we call plague, scourge, catastrophe. But if the gods-from-stone were reborn, would they still be plagues? Would renewal bring peace? The Arts Unregarded hint that it might be so.

Data:Commit.pre.s.meniscatereflections.j.label: What Might Be
Data:Commit.pre.s.meniscatereflections.j.startdescription: Dream of a city of perfect balance. There can be no perfect balance outside dream. Meditate on the Hour named Meniscate, whose light distinguishes the possible from the real. Let the City remain unbuilt; let the perfection of eternity be Preserved.
Data:Commit.pre.s.meniscatereflections.j.desc: Dream of a city of perfect balance. There can be no perfect balance outside dream. Meditate on the Hour named Meniscate, whose light distinguishes the possible from the real. Let the City remain unbuilt.

Data:Commit.pre.s.quenchings.quellings.j.label: Safety in Oblivion
Data:Commit.pre.s.quenchings.quellings.j.startdescription: Let the flesh forget disease, let the smoke forget the flame, let the troubled mind forget its pain: Preservation.
Data:Commit.pre.s.quenchings.quellings.j.desc: Let the flesh forget disease, let the smoke forget the flame, let the troubled mind forget its pain.

Data:Commit.pre.s.ramsund.json.label: The Thief's Tale
Data:Commit.pre.s.ramsund.json.startdescription: There's a very old story told by thieves about a competition among the aviform Hours - the secret gods who take the shape of birds. The dove boasted of the bones he'd stolen from flesh, and the crow of the flesh he'd picked from bones. One of the kite-twins bragged that that she'd stolen the borders from kingdoms, and the other that she'd taken the roads from crossroads. The magpie told all the colours he'd taken that are no longer found in the world, and the laughingthrush topped that with the tales of the sights she'd stolen. But when the glitter-winged seventh of their number told them what he'd stolen, they all were shocked into silence. They fell upon him and stripped him of his wings and drove him from the sky. So he, and what he stole, are gone from the world, and now we cannot even name them, but still we feel their lack.
Data:Commit.pre.s.ramsund.json.desc: There's a very old story told by thieves about a competition among the aviform Hours - the secret gods who take the shape of birds. The dove boasted of the bones he'd stolen from flesh, and the crow of the flesh he'd picked from bones. Data:Commit.pre.s.resurgences.emergences.label: Moth and Grail
Data:Commit.pre.s.resurgences.emergences.startdescription: The gods-from-Stone made a law that the keys of dream cannot be held or owned. The time of Stone is past, but the keys remain. So the holders of these keys can only be the seven Ligeians, whose crime has set them outside the law. And the Ligeians serve an Hour of Moth and Grail: when the last remnants of the gods-from-Stone are renewed, the law will be renewed with them. Preservation is the wisdom of renewal.
Data:Commit.pre.s.resurgences.emergences.desc: The gods-from-Stone made a law that the keys of dream cannot be held or owned. The time of Stone is past, but the keys remain. So the holders of these keys can only be the seven Ligeians, whose crime has set them outside the law. The Ligeians serve an Hour of Moth and Grail: when the last remnants of the gods-from-Stone are renewed, the law will be renewed with them.

Data:Commit.pre.s.rites.theroots.json.label: What is Given
Data:Commit.pre.s.rites.theroots.json.startdescription: The oldest living Hours are the gods-who-were-blood. The gods-from-Stone were older still, but they're buried in the earth, scattered in the sea, lost to the moon. This is why we're always careful where we make the sacrifice: without it, the gods-from-Stone would pass from memory. This is Preservation.
Data:Commit.pre.s.rites.theroots.json.desc: The oldest living Hours are the gods-who-were-blood. The gods-from-Stone were older still, but they're buried in the earth, scattered in the sea, lost to the moon. This is why we're always careful where we make the sacrifice: without it, the gods-from-Stone would pass from memory.

Data:Commit.pre.s.sickle.eclipse.json.label: Secret, Safe
Data:Commit.pre.s.sickle.eclipse.json.startdescription: Let's keep night-things in the night so that day-things can walk in the day. That's Preservation.
Data:Commit.pre.s.sickle.eclipse.json.desc: Let's keep night-things in the night so that day-things can walk in the day.

Data:Commit.pre.s.stitching.binding.json.label: To Heal
Data:Commit.pre.s.stitching.binding.json.startdescription: A deft enough binding might heal anything: flesh; spirit; song; stone. That would be Preservation.
Data:Commit.pre.s.stitching.binding.json.desc: A deft enough binding might heal anything: flesh; spirit; song; stone.

Data:Commit.pre.s.stonestories.json.label: A Vigilance
Data:Commit.pre.s.stonestories.json.startdescription: The Hours once called Flint and the Wheel are gone, but the blood of their Name-emanations was mingled with the blood of mortals, and from it sprang the line of Antaios. As long as the Antaian line continues, the legacy of Flint and Wheel may endure. This then is Preservation.
Data:Commit.pre.s.stonestories.json.desc: The Hours once called Flint and the Wheel are gone, but the blood of their Name-emanations was mingled with the blood of mortals, and from it sprang the line of Antaios. As long as the Antaian line continues, the legacy of Flint and Wheel may endure.

Data:Commit.pre.s.surgeries.exsanguinati.label: The Golden
Data:Commit.pre.s.surgeries.exsanguinati.startdescription: In the times when nothing was forgotten, three flowers bloomed on the Watchman's Tree: Black, Red, and Gold. Red is the life that flows in the body's courses, but the blood of the Carapace Cross was golden. Preservation teaches what endures.
Data:Commit.pre.s.surgeries.exsanguinati.desc: In the times when nothing was forgotten, three flowers bloomed on the Watchman's Tree: Black, Red, and Gold. Red is the life that flows in the body's courses, but the blood of the Carapace Cross was golden.

Data:Commit.pre.s.tridesmahiera.json.label: The Light, the Night, the Wood
Data:Commit.pre.s.tridesmahiera.json.startdescription: What lit the Wood in the days before its darkening? There was a light upon the earth long before Glory came to the sky. Preserve the night, and the light might return.
Data:Commit.pre.s.tridesmahiera.json.desc: What lit the Wood in the days before its darkening? There was a light upon the earth long before Glory came to the sky. Preserve the night, and the light might return.

Data:Commit.sko.s.coil.chasm.json.label: Serpent
Data:Commit.sko.s.coil.chasm.json.startdescription: The Night Arts speak of the Savage Door, to which Echidna, mother of monsters, keeps her Savage Key. It was the means by which the gods-who-were-stone entered the Mansus; for Echidna was once counted among their Names. All skolekosophists seek to understand what this might mean.
Data:Commit.sko.s.coil.chasm.json.desc: The Night Arts speak of the Savage Door, to which Echidna, mother of monsters, keeps her Savage Key. It was the means by which the gods-who-were-stone entered the Mansus; for Echidna was once counted among their Names.

Data:Commit.sko.s.edictsliminal.json.label: Scolecite
Data:Commit.sko.s.edictsliminal.json.startdescription: There is a prophecy of a glorious City that mortals could raise, but the Hours of the Chancel have decreed that it will not exist. The decrees of the Chancel are not defied, but now and then they have been circumvented… and we might conceive that City with walls of shining scolecite could be raised Nowhere; in the darkness below dreams. This would be Skolekosophy.
Data:Commit.sko.s.edictsliminal.json.desc: There is a prophecy of a glorious City that mortals could raise, but the Hours of the Chancel have decreed that it will not exist. The decrees of the Chancel are not defied, but now and then they have been circumvented… and we might conceive that City with walls of shining flint could be raised Nowhere; in the darkness below dreams.

Data:Commit.sko.s.horns.ivories.json.label: The Chandler's Path
Data:Commit.sko.s.horns.ivories.json.startdescription: When the Chandler goes a-hunting in the dark of the Wood, he shields his candle so his prey is not forewarned, but he leaves a trail of ivory wax so we may follow him and purchase his prizes. After all, the goal of every hunt is to bring home a trophy, and when we understand Skolekosophy, we know how to bargain.
Data:Commit.sko.s.horns.ivories.json.desc: When the Chandler goes a-hunting in the dark of the Wood, he shields his candle so his prey is not forewarned, but he leaves a trail of ivory wax so we may follow him and purchase his prizes. After all, the goal of every hunt is to bring home a trophy.

Data:Commit.sko.s.hyksos.json.label: The Dartsmen
Data:Commit.sko.s.hyksos.json.startdescription: The assassins of the Tragulari, who end the long lives of Long, tell stories of the wars between the Hours in the dawn of the world, when the sun was red and low - wars where the savage sound of savage bells unravelled the light of moon and sun - wars where dreams burned on pyres where Long were the fuel. All this ended, the Tragulari say, once the Worms came, and the Hours had a common enemy. And so the Tragulari fear Worms; hate Worms; and make offerings to Worms.
Data:Commit.sko.s.hyksos.json.desc: The assassins of the Tragulari, who end the long lives of Long, tell stories of the wars between the Hours in the dawn of the world, when the sun was red and low - wars where the savage sound of savage bells unravelled the light of moon and sun - wars where dreams burned on pyres where Long were the fuel. All this ended, the Tragulari say, once the Worms came, and the Hours had a common enemy. And so the Tragulari fear Worms; hate Worms; and make offerings to Worms.

Data:Commit.sko.s.killasimi.json.label: The Carpenter's Tale
Data:Commit.sko.s.killasimi.json.startdescription: There is a prophecy among carpenters: a master of their kind will resolve, unwisely, that the coffins he shapes are too beautiful to sully with corpses. He will steal trinkets from the dead, he will ask the help of smiths and jewellers, and day and night he will labour to shape something worthy of his work. At last he will tire of his task and offer his breath to the shape in the casket. When it accepts, it will rise from the coffin and pronounce itself King. It will rule by fear, or fear will destroy it. In either case, its maker will have no coffin and no grave, and his name will be lost.
Data:Commit.sko.s.killasimi.json.desc: There is a prophecy of a master-carpenter who will resolve, unwisely, that the coffins he shapes are too beautiful to sully with corpses. He will steal trinkets from the dead, he will ask the help of smiths and jewellers, and day and night he will labour to shape something worthy of his work. At last he will tire of his task and offer his breath to the shape in the casket. When it accepts, it will rise from the coffin and pronounce itself King. Data:Commit.sko.s.lockworks.clockworks.j.label: Of Locks
Data:Commit.sko.s.lockworks.clockworks.j.startdescription: The locksmith's first duty: a key for every lock, and a lock for every key. If a key were an Hour, what lock would it open? Skolekosophy might hold the answer.
Data:Commit.sko.s.lockworks.clockworks.j.desc: The locksmith's first duty: a key for every lock, and a lock for every key. If a key were an Hour, what lock would it open?

Data:Commit.sko.s.orchids.narcotics.json.label: The Chandler's Kindling
Data:Commit.sko.s.orchids.narcotics.json.startdescription: If flowers are flame, the earth is their fuel. The Hour named Flowermaker cannot harm us, and he cannot find us, but he always has what we desire, and the Hour named Chandler can bring the spark to light the flame. These are the temptations of Skolekosophy.
Data:Commit.sko.s.orchids.narcotics.json.desc: If flowers are flame, the earth is their fuel. The Hour named Flowermaker cannot harm us, and he cannot find us, but he always has what we desire, and the Hour named Chandler can bring the spark to light the flame.

Data:Commit.sko.s.pentiments.precursors..label: Carapace
Data:Commit.sko.s.pentiments.precursors..startdescription: Of the Ligeian Medusa, it has been said: 'She might be the oldest of her kind still living; and she is dead.' Skolekosophists might interpret this thus: she is the oldest of the Seglaz-kind, which is to say of a Carapace-lineage famed for the breadth of their wisdom and the complexity of their teeth.
Data:Commit.sko.s.pentiments.precursors..desc: Of the Ligeian Medusa, it has been said: 'She might be the oldest of her kind still living; and she is dead.' Skolekosophists say she is the oldest of the Seglaz-kind, of a Carapace-lineage famed for the breadth of their wisdom and the sharpness of their teeth.

Data:Commit.sko.s.putrefactions.calcinat.label: In Ashes
Data:Commit.sko.s.putrefactions.calcinat.startdescription: All days are death, all lives are sunset. For a time, light persists, but we should not fear the scorch of a Second Dawn. This is Skolekosophy at its most merciful.
Data:Commit.sko.s.putrefactions.calcinat.desc: All days are death, all lives are sunset. For a time, light persists, but we should not fear the scorch of a Second Dawn.

Data:Commit.sko.s.raggedcrossroads.json.label: At the Threshold
Data:Commit.sko.s.raggedcrossroads.json.startdescription: Every regret is a threshold; and every threshold can be crossed in both directions. A skolekosophist knows that no threshold need remain inviolate.
Data:Commit.sko.s.raggedcrossroads.json.desc: Every regret is a threshold; and every threshold can be crossed in both directions. No threshold need remain inviolate.

Data:Commit.sko.s.rhyme.remembrance.json.label: Secrecy; Knowledge; Power
Data:Commit.sko.s.rhyme.remembrance.json.startdescription:
The sights we name are rarely named by day
The shapes we seek are rarely sought in clay
The names we claim are often claimed as pay.'

This is Skolekosophy.
Data:Commit.sko.s.rhyme.remembrance.json.desc:
The sights we name are rarely named by day
The shapes we seek are rarely sought in clay
The names we claim are often claimed as pay.'

Data:Commit.sko.s.sandstories.json.label: A Temple
Data:Commit.sko.s.sandstories.json.startdescription: The seven tainted immortals we call Ligeians are relentless in their appetite, and outcast under the laws of heaven. But they have their uses to the Hours. The Ligeian Echidna learnt her shaping arts in the world's dawn, and even now the Lionsmith values her skill; so every year they meet in the desert, among the furnace shadows of the Seven-Coiled temple, to share their knowledge of how monsters were made. We call their stories Skolekosophy.
Data:Commit.sko.s.sandstories.json.desc: The seven tainted immortals we call Ligeians are relentless in their appetite, and outcast under the laws of heaven. But they have their uses to the Hours. The Ligeian Echidna learnt her shaping arts in the world's dawn, and even now the Lionsmith values her skill; so every year they meet in the desert, among the furnace shadows of the Seven-Coiled temple, to share their knowledge of how monsters were made.

Data:Commit.sko.s.serpents.venoms.json.label: The First Sun
Data:Commit.sko.s.serpents.venoms.json.startdescription: In the dawn times the sun was lower, so we gave it our blood. From our blood it knew us, and so it was kinder. But those days are long gone. If we were foolish enough to find the first Sun and give it our blood again, it would devour us. If we fed it the blood of our enemies, of course, it might devour them. This is the kind of thing you hear from skolekosophists.
Data:Commit.sko.s.serpents.venoms.json.desc: In the dawn times the sun was lower, so we gave it our blood. From our blood it knew us, and so it was kinder. But those days are long gone. If we were foolish enough to find the first Sun and give it our blood again, it would devour us. If we fed it the blood of our enemies, of course, it might devour them.

Data:Commit.sko.s.sharps.json.label: A War in Dreams
Data:Commit.sko.s.sharps.json.startdescription: Before speech, we could not dream, which is to say that before we could wield words, we were weaponless, and even Long dared not enter the Mansus for fear of being devoured. It's not obligatory for Long to wield the weapons of speech, but they generally choose to. Perhaps that's why the Hours charge their Names to hunt down Long - even the Long who claim to serve them. Skolekosophy recognises this truth.
Data:Commit.sko.s.sharps.json.desc: Before speech, we could not dream, which is to say that before we could wield words, we were weaponless, and even Long dared not enter the Mansus for fear of being devoured. It's not obligatory for Long to wield the weapons of speech, but they generally choose to. Perhaps that's why the Hours charge their Names to hunt down Long - even the Long who claim to serve them.

Data:Commit.sko.s.solutions.separations..label: The Crooked
Data:Commit.sko.s.solutions.separations..startdescription: The world is all imbalance, and imbalance is opportunity. Moth knows that; Worms prove it. This is Skolekosophy.
Data:Commit.sko.s.solutions.separations..desc: The world is all imbalance, and imbalance is opportunity. Moth knows that; Worms prove it.

Data:Commit.sko.s.wolfstories.json.label: The Wolf's Beginning
Data:Commit.sko.s.wolfstories.json.startdescription: The Received Version of the Book of Suns tells us that the Wolf-Divided was born from the Sun-in-Splendour's division. We know from this that the Sun can be reborn only if the Wolf joins the Sun's other selves. Only if the Wolf's hunger is assuaged will it join its other selves. And only the flesh of its other selves can assuage the hunger of the Wolf. A Second Dawn would herald the Last Day. This is the grim lesson of Skolekosophy.
Data:Commit.sko.s.wolfstories.json.desc: The Received Version of the Book of Suns tells us that the Wolf-Divided was born from the Sun-in-Splendour's division. We know from this that the Sun can be reborn only if the Wolf joins the Sun's other selves. Only if the Wolf's hunger is assuaged will it join its other selves. And only the flesh of its other selves can assuage the hunger of the Wolf. A Second Dawn would herald the Last Day.

Data:Compasses.forge.json.Label: Compasses
Data:Compasses.forge.json.Desc: Invaluable for accurate circles, for accurate navigation, and in a grave emergency, for self-defence.

xexts.scrutiny: There is no blood on the compass-points. It has not been used for self-defence. Or it has been used for self-defence only by a hygienic owner.

Data:Confounding.parable.json.Label: Confounding Parable
Data:Confounding.parable.json.Desc: 'The Moth, the Grail, and the Egg Unhatching all tell different stories of the world's beginning. One of those stories is the oldest, but it may not be the first.' - Abbess Nonna
